svg.title: Ring: distribute the completed chunks
svg.desc: Four GPUs arranged in a ring each forward one chunk per step. They fill missing positions and all hold [1111, 2222, 3333, 4444] after three steps.
svg.text: Receive completed chunks to fill missing vector positions, without adding again.
Send the one chunk shown on each arrow, and retain received chunks.
Done: the same array on all four GPUs
